summary: Refactor-safety regression for engine/ split into interfaces + ScanEngine + providers. Backend: reran existing pytest suite (/app/backend/tests/backend_test.py) against the live external URL — 8/8 tests PASS (firm GET/PUT, clients CRUD, seeded templates + template CRUD, file upload/list/soft-delete, full scan pipeline queued->scanning->completed with exact_duplicate/wrong_period/missing_doc/unreadable counts, findings PATCH, and CSV/XLSX/PDF report exports all non-empty). No regressions detected.

issues: Pre-existing (iter_1): Emergent ve-dynamic wrapper injects <span> inside <option> triggering hydration warnings. Not caused by this refactor. Non-blocking.

critical_code_review_comments: engine/scan_engine.py + providers/ split is clean and keeps run_detection backward-compatible via delegation in detect.py — good separation for the future Tauri/local build.

PaddleOCRProvider and OllamaLLMProvider are inactive stubs as expected; ensure they are behind a feature flag (or import-guarded) so accidental instantiation in the web build doesn't require paddleocr/ollama deps.

Pre-existing (iter_1, not introduced now): server.py _run_scan still uses asyncio.get_event_loop() (prefer get_running_loop); list_clients still N+1; delete_client not atomic. Refactor didn't address these — main agent may want to schedule.
Consider adding a lightweight adapter-level unit test for LocalPathFileSource and NoOp providers so future changes to the interface contract fail fast.
